items.title: Canton Strategic Holdings doubles third-quarter revenue to $3.05 million and turns adjusted EBITDA positive for the first time
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 3:12 AM ET)
- **Canton Strategic Holdings doubles third-quarter revenue to $3.05 million and turns adjusted EBITDA positive for the first time** — The Nasdaq-listed company (CNTN) reported on November 16 total revenue of $3,051,232 for the quarter ended September 30, up 104% from $1,495,859 in the second quarter, in its first full quarter of Super Validator and locking-as-a-service operations; network validation revenue rose to $1,503,238 as active Super Validator weight climbed from 0.5 to 6.5 of 15 approved, other revenue was $1,547,994, mostly locking-as-a-service, and adjusted EBITDA was $610,414 against a loss of $820,449 in the second quarter, while a $54.65 million unrealized loss on its digital-asset holdings drove a net loss of $35,078,297 (PR Newswire)
- **Nomura, NRI and BOOSTRY set out a joint plan to connect financial firms to onchain markets on Canton** — In their November 16 announcement, NRI is developing a service that captures blockchain transactions and balances in real time into its I-STAR securities back-office systems, BOOSTRY says its Canton-first institutional wallet entered production in September and that it has completed a protocol connecting Canton to its ibet for Fin digital-securities platform, and the three intend to examine government and corporate bonds, shares and funds from issuance through settlement and collateral use; the collaboration is still under consideration and builds on the single shared Super Validator arrangement approved under CIP-0130, with up to 10 reward weight in total (CantonNews)
- **Total Canton Coin burned passes 6.13 billion as fee burns run at about four coins for every five minted** — CantonScan data put the cumulative burn at 6.13 billion CC as of November 16, up from 6.05 billion recorded on November 15, with about $1.15 million worth burned in the 24 hours to November 16; because new CC is minted as rewards, burns at roughly 80% of minting mean supply still grows modestly rather than contracting, against about 40 billion CC in circulation (BSC News)
- **Splice release notes reach version 0.10.2, upgrading Canton to 3.7.3 and removing the last CometBFT support** — The 0.10.2 notes add CIP-104 v1.1 featured-asset activity fields to Scan event responses, add governance support for the amended traffic-based reward calculation, and remove the remaining CometBFT endpoints, metrics and charts from the Super Validator app; the release train follows the MainNet upgrade to Splice 0.10.0 that was listed for November 16 (Canton Network Docs)

items.title: Canton keeps issuance and settlement as separate jobs, unlike a single public ledger
items.body:

items.title: Governance locks bring Super Validator and Featured App locking enforcement on-chain under CIP-0127
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 14, 2026 · 9:12 AM ET)
- **Governance locks bring Super Validator and Featured App locking enforcement on-chain under CIP-0127** — The Canton documentation now details how governance locks will work from Splice 0.10.0: CIP-0105 requires Super Validators to lock a percentage of their aggregate lifetime rewards to keep their weight, CIP-0116 requires each Featured App provider to lock a minimum amount of Canton Coin to gain and keep featured status, and CIP-0127 is the functional specification that moves enforcement of both onto the ledger itself; every lock must hold at least 10,000 CC, Super Validator locks vest over 365.25 days after an unlock while Featured App locks vest over 60 days, and wallet providers have been asked to expand memo fields to 1,000 characters because lock data is encoded in the transfer memo in compatibility mode (Canton Network Docs)
- **SBI Holdings and Cambodia's central bank plan a tokenized government-bond trial on Canton** — SBI Holdings and the National Bank of Cambodia signed a memorandum of understanding on November 13 for a proof of concept in tokenized Cambodian government bonds, with Canton planned as the network and the aim of making bond investment accessible in smaller amounts through local financial institutions; the central bank will register and manage bondholder information, SBI Bank (Cambodia) will work on technical verification of tokenization and transfers, and SBI Digital Practice will build and operate the trial environment, with interim results and a demonstration planned for the Black Swan Summit in Phnom Penh on November 15–16, and a separate memorandum the same day covers a Japan–Cambodia remittance proof of concept; the bond work is a planned trial, not a live issuance (CantonNews)
- **CapConnect+ seeks a Super Validator role under CIP-0131 to settle commercial paper and its cash payment together on Canton** — The proposal, in a vote that opened November 10 with Tradeweb as sponsor and MPCH as endorser, offers a maximum of five reward weight units tied to delivery and adoption milestones, starting with at least $100 million in aggregate commercial-paper issuance settling both the asset and the cash on Canton within six months of approval, then cumulative milestones at $1 billion, $5 billion and $10 billion; the existing CapConnect+ platform, developed in collaboration with Walmart, has facilitated more than $46.11 billion in issuance since full production began in early 2025 on existing settlement infrastructure, which is not Canton volume, and the public document does not identify the anchor issuer for the first Canton transactions (CantonNews)
- **Canton Foundation launches an official Daml 3 developer certification, with free self-paced courses and a $150 exam** — The Canton Developer Certification, launched November 10, pairs free self-paced courses with a certification exam costing $150 per session and is based on Daml 3 and Canton 3.x, the current network stack; it validates practical mastery of Daml's authorization and privacy principles — controlling who may act on a contract and who may access its terms — and gives existing Daml 2 developers a migration path onto the single current platform, with Foundation chief operating officer Amanda Martin framing it as a common professional standard for building in regulated markets (HTX)
- **Canton Coin spot prices widen to 9.06% apart across exchanges, with only a thin best route after fees** — A November 14, 14:02 UTC scan found Canton Coin cheapest on MEXC at $0.07571 and dearest on Bitstamp at $0.082569 across 12 exchanges with a liquid spot market, wider than the 8.19% spread recorded earlier today; the best spot route, buying on Bybit and selling on Kraken, paid only 0.11% after taker fees, about $1.05 on $1,000 at the best book prices, with the transfer status between the exchanges unknown, the best futures route, long WhiteBIT perpetuals against short Lighter perpetuals, paid 0.73% after fees, and no route with a confirmed open transfer was worth taking (ArbitrageGap)

items.title: Ledger Enterprise brings hardware-enforced threshold self-custody to Canton, targeting the single-validator risk in its wallet design
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 4:42 PM ET)
- **Ledger Enterprise brings hardware-enforced threshold self-custody to Canton, targeting the single-validator risk in its wallet design** — A Canton party is usually hosted by a single validator whose operator controls the node software and could in principle change local parameters to bypass standard controls; Ledger instead separates control of the asset from any one operator with a multi-validator setup that requires at least two validators to confirm a transaction, enforces the same threshold again at the signer level inside its HSMs and personal security devices so a compromised operator cannot lower it at the validator, and requires external parties to sign submitted transactions, with client keys held in FIPS 140-2 Level 3 certified hardware (Ledger Enterprise)
- **Zenith's EVM testnet for Canton is publicly live, letting Ethereum developers deploy unmodified Solidity against Canton rails** — The public testnet runs under chain ID 936485 with a faucet, public RPC and explorer, and its external_call primitive lets a Daml contract invoke a Solidity contract inside the same transaction so a Canton-native leg and an EVM leg settle together or not at all; the first milestone is complete, the second targets a demonstrated composability run on mainnet, and support for a Solana virtual machine execution layer is planned next (Bitrue)
- **New Canton–XRP comparison puts Canton Coin's supply growth at about 8.6% this year, ahead of XRP's circulating expansion** — On CoinMarketCap figures, CC supply grew about 8.55% from 36.82 billion at the end of 2025 to 39.97 billion by late October, while circulating XRP grew 4.4% over the same span and XRP's total supply fell by about 158,000 coins as transaction fees are destroyed; the comparison notes CC carries no maximum supply on the major trackers because it is minted as network rewards, whereas XRP was created at inception (Phemex)
- **Ledger Wallet's Canton support runs on a two-validator co-validation model operated with Kiln** — Ledger operates one validator and Kiln operates the second to Ledger's requirements on key generation, custody, recovery and contractual exit; both validators host the same wallets and both must confirm a transaction before the network accepts the resulting state, while balance reads can fail over between them, and Kiln exports the validator database daily to secure storage controlled by Ledger so Ledger holds an independent copy of the state its wallets rely on (Kiln)

items.title: Canton draft would let Super Validators delegate their governance votes to a separate identity
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 1:42 PM ET)
- **Canton draft would let Super Validators delegate their governance votes to a separate identity** — A draft specification submitted on November 11 by Digital Asset's Raymond Roestenburg, not yet assigned a CIP number, would let a Super Validator operator appoint a separate Canton party to submit its votes through a dedicated voting app and a CIP-0103 wallet, without sharing the operator identity that runs the node; operator and delegate share the node's one vote, the latest vote counts, the two-thirds threshold is unchanged, and the operator can change or revoke the delegate and still vote itself; the work follows a 1 million CC grant funding the governance app, and activation would still need a Super Validator vote on updated software (CantonNews)
